title: chore: Add CodeRabbit configuration for content accuracy reviews
author: adiati98
body:
## Description

This PR adds a `.coderabbit.yaml` file to set up CodeRabbit for this repository. CodeRabbit is an automated reviewer that comments on pull requests.

CodeRabbit is only for **content accuracy**. Promptless and Vale already handle the style guide, so CodeRabbit should not comment on those.

### What the review instructions mean

These apply to all `.rst` files in the `docs/` folder.

- **Review for content accuracy only.** CodeRabbit does not review or comment on style, grammar, formatting, links or images. Other tools handle those.
- **Verify the content against the Mautic codebase.** CodeRabbit compares what the docs say with the code. It checks everything developers use, such as class names, method names, namespaces, events, hooks, API endpoints, parameters, return values, config keys, CLI commands, database fields and behavior, and flags anything that does not match.
- **The PR's base branch is the Mautic version, and CodeRabbit compares with the matching code branch.** If there is no code branch with the same name, it uses the code branch for that major version. For example, for docs branch `7.3`, it uses code branch `7.3`, or `7.x` if `7.3` does not exist.
- **If the code looks like a different version, say so.** The code CodeRabbit checks may be newer or older than the docs branch. In that case, it should mention the version difference instead of calling the docs wrong.
- **Check that code samples match the text and work for that version.** This covers samples written in the page and samples included from a file.
- **Linked repository.** `knowledge_base.linked_repositories` links `mautic/mautic`, so CodeRabbit can read the code it compares the docs with.

title: docs: Remove monthly challenges section
author: adiati98
body:
## Linked Issue

Closes #1668

To link a pull request to an issue to show that a fix is in progress and to automatically close the issue when someone merges the pull request, type the keyword "Closes" followed by a reference to the issue. For example, Closes #404 or Closes Virtual-Coffee/virtualcoffee.io/issues/404.

## Description

This PRs remove the "Monthly Challenges" from "Adding content" section on README as we've sunset monthly challenges per January 2026.

A good description informs everyone that is reaading it of the purpose of the pull request. This helps not just the current maintainers but anyone reading it now or in the future to understand your intent.
